ambient_events: The launch rail slews a few degrees on its own, the seeker head hunting the haze.
A wind moves through the grass and sets the empty missile canisters ringing.
Somewhere below the deck a compressor kicks in and labours.
description: A Redline SAM nest thrown up on the old grassland: sandbags and scavenged plate bermed into a rough horseshoe, the launch rail exposed at the centre with two red-striped missiles nosed at the sky. The nest tracks the haze on a groaning powered mount, the crew lounging at it with the ease of people who charge a toll and mean it. A plate hatch, weighted with a truck spring, drops into the bunker where the reloads and the launch electronics are kept out of the weather.
name: Redline SAM Nest
